## [Unreleased]

## [0.2.0] - Unreleased

First production-ready release. It contains breaking changes compared with 0.1.0; 0.1.0 should not be used.

### Changed

- Requests and responses use typed models generated from the API contract.
- Errors are classified by the `error.type` of the API error envelope, with the HTTP status as a fallback; the `hint` field, which the API never sent, is removed.
- Retries happen only for requests that are safe to repeat (idempotent methods, or requests carrying an `Idempotency-Key`), with jittered exponential backoff that honours `retry-after-ms` and `Retry-After`.
- Timeouts cover the whole request, are configurable per client and per request, and combine with caller-supplied cancellation.
- Server-sent events are delivered incrementally; closing or abandoning a stream closes the connection.
- List methods return typed pages and offer an auto-paging iterator.
- Webhook verification enforces the timestamp tolerance against the system clock and reports every failure as a typed error.
- Money helpers parse decimal strings exactly; tiyn amounts are 64-bit integers.
- The default base URL is `https://api.tungo.kz`; it can be set with `TUNGO_BASE_URL`.
- Every method accepts per-request options (`WithHeader`, `WithRequestTimeout`, `WithMaxRetries`, `WithIdempotencyKey`, `WithResponseInto`, ...); the same options configure the client.
- The company and workspace are client options (`WithCompanyID`, `WithWorkspaceID`), overridable per request; the `Co`/`Ws` fields of the params structs are gone.
- Discriminated unions (`ChatEvent`, `WebhookEvent`, ...) are tagged unions with one struct per variant; primitive unions are real union types. A valid response no longer fails to decode.
- Nullable request fields are `Nullable[T]`, so `null`, an empty list and a zero value can be sent in PATCH bodies; models keep unknown response fields (`RawJSON`, `ExtraFields`).
- Errors are `*APIError` (with `Kind`), `*ConnectionError`, `*TimeoutError`, `*DecodeError`, `*ConfigError`, `*ValidationError`; a missing API key is a `*ConfigError`, not a fake 401.
- `http.Client.Timeout` is no longer used: timeouts are contexts, so streams are not cut after 30 s. Streams have an idle timeout instead.
- List methods return a page with `HasNext`/`Next`; `*All` methods return an `iter.Seq2` instead of a slice.
- Streaming methods return `*ChatStream` / `*Stream[T]` with typed events, `Close`, and the dialog id and turn number from the response headers.
- `VerifyWebhook` takes the raw body and `http.Header`, uses the system clock and rejects an empty secret; `ToTiyn` takes a decimal string and returns an error for invalid input.
- `fmt` verbs no longer print the API key of a client.

## [0.1.0] - 2026-11-09

Initial preview. Not suitable for production use.
